conversion: User-authorized local resizing with macOS sips to 160 × 160 RGBA PNGs, preserving generated transparency and the original source images.
notes: Generated with existing Laughing, Crying and Surprised artwork as style references. Original source files preserved. Five additions to the existing chat reaction set.

assets.label: Happy
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one production chat-reaction PNG for the Twinkle website, displayed at 24–28 CSS pixels.
Input images: the attached existing Laughing, Crying and Surprised icons are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. Make one new matching member of exactly this family.
Style: friendly polished 2.5D emoji, round golden-yellow spherical face, warm amber volume shading along the lower-right, broad soft creamy highlight at upper-left, clean warm dark-brown facial features. Match the references' face size, lighting, rich yellow, soft sculpted surface and simple expressive proportions. Contour is the softly shaded object edge: no drawn black outline, sticker border, halo, or decorative ring.
Composition: a single complete face centered on a square, filling approximately 92% of the canvas with even transparent padding, no clipping. Keep broad readable details at 24px. No text, letters, labels, watermark, extra symbols, stars, background scene, ground plane or exterior cast shadow.
Output: a compact 160 × 160 RGBA PNG with genuine transparent alpha background and clean antialiased edges. Never draw a checkerboard.
Subject: A genuinely HAPPY smile: relaxed raised cheeks, friendly crescent-shaped smiling eyes, softly arched brows, a broad curved CLOSED smile in warm dark brown. Calm delighted happiness, distinctly different from the existing open-mouth Laughing icon. No teeth, tongue, tears or hands.
